items.title: Graph neural networks for molecular property prediction in drug discovery: a 2025 benchmark
items.abstract: We benchmark graph neural network architectures for molecular property prediction across drug discovery datasets, covering solubility, toxicity and bioactivity endpoints.

items.title: A message passing neural network for chemical property prediction in molecular discovery
items.abstract: We introduce a message passing neural network variant that improves chemical property prediction accuracy on molecular discovery benchmarks.

items.title: Chemprop: directed message passing for molecular property prediction in drug discovery
items.abstract: We present Chemprop, a deep learning framework using directed message passing for molecular property prediction in drug discovery.

items.title: Solid electrolyte interphase formation in lithium batteries
items.abstract: A decoy record on battery interface chemistry, unrelated to the tracking question.
